_comment: Public Trello sync config. Secrets live in runner/trello.config.local.json (gitignored). Single project board model: ONE board for the whole product (here: TailTrack); each feature identified by a feat:<feature_short_id> label. Per-task trello_card_id is written into tasks.json after first sync. Migration from per-feature boards: runner/trello-migrate-to-project-board.sh (one-shot).

project_board.name: TailTrack
project_board.description: TailTrack — single project board synced from this repo's specs/. Each feature (001, 002, 003, …) is identified by a feat:<feature_short_id> label. Lists track lifecycle (Pending / In Progress / Blocked / Completed). Cards prefixed [<feature_short_id>] for at-a-glance ID.

feature_labels._comment: Auto-created on first sync of each feature. Colors rotate through color_pool by feature index (001=first, 002=second, …). Trello has ~10 colors; pool deduped against owner_labels to avoid visual collision.

_deprecated_will_be_removed._comment: Legacy keys retained for one release so trello-migrate-to-project-board.sh can still read the previous per-feature topology. trello-sync.sh + task-update.sh no longer use these.
